value.signature: fn decode_material (input : & [u8] , edition : & str) -> Result < AuthenticationMaterial , EncodingError >

review.body: { if edition != AUTHENTICATION_EDITION { return Err (EncodingError :: Edition) ; } let value = canonical (input) ? ; let [e , run , actor_key , host_identity , host_key] = items (& value) ? else { return Err (EncodingError :: Shape) ; } ; if string (e) ? != edition { return Err (EncodingError :: Edition) ; } let result = AuthenticationMaterial { run : fixed (run) ? , actor_key : fixed (actor_key) ? , host_identity : string (host_identity) ? . into () , host_key : fixed (host_key) ? , } ; if ! host (& result . host_identity) { return Err (EncodingError :: Shape) ; } Ok (result) }
review.item_premise: Complete public arguments and results are recorded, including retained bytes. This operation establishes representation or comparison only, never signature validity, secret possession or chain authority.
